hook_line: PHILLIPS' 107 POWERS NEW ZEALAND TO RECORD 259/7 AND 87-RUN WIN OVER INDIA

hook_stat.sub: New Zealand's highest-ever T20I total, at Eden Park

stats.label: Glenn Phillips' runs off 49 balls, his third T20I century
Michael Bracewell's runs off 25 balls in a 115-run fifth-wicket stand
Jacob Duffy's figures as India were restricted to 172

diaspora_bullets: India still lead the series 3-1 with one match to play
Arshdeep Singh became the first Indian to 150 T20I wickets
news_summary: New Zealand posted 259/7 at Eden Park, their highest-ever T20I total and the highest score ever made against India, and beat India by 87 runs in the fourth T20I.
payoff: India still lead the series 3-1, with one match to play.
